title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 22: Micaiah's warning, Ahab's death at Ramoth Gilead and the reigns of Jehoshaphat and Ahaziah.

questions.text: Which city did the king of Israel say was theirs, though it was still in the hand of the king of Syria?
questions.explanation: The king of Israel told his servants that Ramoth Gilead was theirs, yet they did nothing to take it out of the hand of the king of Syria.

questions.text: Why did the king of Israel say he hated Micaiah the son of Imlah?
questions.explanation: The king said he hated Micaiah because he did not prophesy good concerning him, but evil.

answers.text: He had refused to come to the gate of Samaria
He had sided with the king of Syria
He did not prophesy good concerning him, but evil
He had mocked the other prophets in public

questions.text: What did Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah make for himself?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah made himself horns of iron and said that with these they would push the Syrians until they were consumed.

questions.text: In his vision, how did Micaiah see all Israel scattered on the mountains?
questions.explanation: Micaiah said he saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd.

answers.text: As chaff driven by the wind
As an army fleeing from battle
As travelers who had lost their way
As sheep that have no shepherd

questions.text: What did the spirit who stood before Yahweh say it would become in order to entice Ahab?
questions.explanation: The spirit said, 'I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.'

answers.text: A watchman on the walls of Samaria
A lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets
A dream that would trouble the king at night
A messenger sent from the king of Syria

questions.text: What did Zedekiah do to Micaiah after hearing his prophecy?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah came near, struck Micaiah on the cheek and asked which way Yahweh's Spirit went from him to speak to Micaiah.

answers.text: He struck him on the cheek
He threw him into a pit
He drove him out of the city

questions.text: What did the king of Israel do before going into the battle?
questions.explanation: The king of Israel told Jehoshaphat, 'I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes,' and he disguised himself.

answers.text: He put on his royal robes
He sent his son to lead the army

questions.text: What wounded the king of Israel in the battle?
questions.explanation: A certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor.

answers.text: A man's bow, drawn at random

questions.text: Where did they wash the chariot after the king died?
questions.explanation: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria, and the dogs licked up his blood, according to Yahweh's word.

answers.text: At the gate of Ramoth Gilead

questions.explanation: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they did not go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.
